description: Check a website's TLS setup: certificate expiry and days remaining, chain validity, hostname match, negotiated TLS version, cipher strength, and whether HTTP redirects to HTTPS. No KinetixSEO account needed. A site checked in the last 24 hours gets that stored result. Free: spends no credits.

url.description: The website to check: a domain (example.com) or any URL on it. The home page of that domain is checked.

name: check_ssl_certificate
title: Check SSL certificate
